recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century soul album cover featuring a group of men in military-inspired attire resting in a sun-bleached desert landscape, topped with centered, high-contrast serif typography against a pale, hazy sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-heavy upper half balanced by figure-heavy lower half
Warm sepia-toned imagery against a neutral cream background
Horizontal horizon line bisecting the composition
Sharp, dark typography contrasting with the soft, grainy photographic texture
coreInvariants: Centered vertical alignment of all text elements
Monochromatic sepia/brown color palette for the photography
Uniform cream-colored negative space in the upper quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five figures are positioned in the lower third of the frame, appearing at a medium-long shot distance, lounging on a sandy incline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The centered block of text in the upper-middle section acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left 'STEREO' marker, moves down to the central title, and finally rests on the group of figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive open space in the top half representing a bright, overcast sky.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background providing a vintage paper feel.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark charcoal/brown for typography and deep shadows in the photo.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted sepia and tan tones within the photographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the text and the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure blacks; use deep browns or charcoals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying case and scale for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small technical 'STEREO' text in top left corner
Small rectangular logo box in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the elegant, high-contrast humanist serif feel of the era.
Strong bracketed serifs and classical proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s style photograph of five men in dark military-style jackets and light trousers lounging on a sandy desert dune. The image should be sepia-toned and grainy, occupying only the bottom half of a square frame. The top half should be a solid, slightly textured cream-colored sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered dark brown serif text in the upper half. The first line should be in mixed case, followed by three lines of all-caps text stacked vertically. Add a small 'STEREO' label in the top left corner in a simple sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the photographic portion restricted to the bottom half?
Is the color palette limited to cream, tan, and dark brown?
Does the typography have sharp, high-contrast serifs?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the cream background
Number of figures in the desert scene
mustRedesign: Remove any specific retail price stickers
Change the specific band name and album title text

mustAchieve: Balanced negative space in the upper quadrant

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the image looks like a physical printed object with slight edge wear.
Check that the text does not overlap the figures.
Verify the 'STEREO' text is small and unobtrusive.
Confirm the desert horizon is relatively flat and horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered high-contrast serif title block with a low-positioned, monochromatic vintage photograph against a textured neutral background.
